text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Standing at 180 cm tall, Hishi Akebono is a big Umamusume, and her dream is to become someone who can satisfy others with her races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In other words, she dreams to become chanko!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her towering frame has been turning heads since before her debut, but she'll need a resilient body if she hopes to take advantage of her size.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Therefore, our main goal is to bulk up and strengthen her body as we set forth to take on the Twinkle Series!
